  "meaningfully_distinct": true,
  "evidence_ids": [
    "E1.1"
  ],
  "reasons": [
    "According to NCERT Accountancy (Company Accounts), when a shareholder pays call money before the directors make the call, it is known as 'Calls in Advance'.",
    "Excerpt E1.1 states: 'The amount received in advance is a liability of the company and should be credited to Call in Advance Account. The amount received will be adjusted towards the payment of calls as and when they becomes due.'",
    "Hence, Option C is uniquely supported and correct."
  ],
  "syllabus_chapter": "Share Capital",
  "syllabus_topic": "Calls in advance",
  "syllabus_entitlement": true,
  "presentation_ready": true,
  "question_type_match": true,
  "principle_applicability": "excerpt_required",
  "decisive_principle_in_excerpts": true,
  "answer_conditions": [
    {
      "condition": "Money paid by a shareholder towards an uncalled instalment is treated as calls in advance, credited to Calls in Advance A/c, and shown as a liability until due.",
      "status": "convention",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": [
        "E1.1"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "option_challenges": [
    {
      "option": "A",
      "strongest_reading": "Assume uncalled money received can be immediately added to paid-up share capital equity.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "option": "B",
      "strongest_reading": "Assume calls in arrears account is used whenever call money is received outside normal timing.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "option": "D",
      "strongest_reading": "Assume any amount paid in excess of regular called capital constitutes securities premium.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    }
  ],
  "blocking_defects": [],
  "style_notes": [],
  "cuet_fit": {
    "criteria": {
      "syllabus_objective": {
        "level": 3,
        "evidence": "Directly assesses 'Calls in advance' under Unit IV Company Accounts."
      },
      "format_authenticity": {
        "level": 3,
        "evidence": "Standard objective 4-option conceptual MCQ matching authenticated CUET Accountancy papers."
      },
      "level_calibration": {
        "level": 3,
        "evidence": "Direct concept recall/application calibrated with cuet2024-accountancy-bookA-q14."
      },
      "discrimination_value": {
        "level": 3,
        "evidence": "Distractors target common student confusions (share capital, calls in arrears, securities premium)."
      }
    },
    "reasoning_steps": 1,
    "estimated_difficulty": "easy",
    "cognitive_level": "recall",
    "exemplar_ids_compared": [
      "cuet2024-accountancy-bookA-q6",
      "cuet2024-accountancy-bookA-q14"
    ]
  },
  "option_resolution": [
    {
      "option": "A",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Credit it to Share Capital A/c immediately and treat it as part of owners' equity",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "The amount received in advance is a liability of the company and should be credited to ‘Call in Advance Account.”",
      "reason": "Calls in advance cannot be credited to Share Capital before the call is due."
    },
    {
      "option": "B",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Credit it to Calls in Arrears A/c and show it as an asset of the company",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "The amount received in advance is a liability of the company and should be credited to ‘Call in Advance Account.”",
      "reason": "Calls in arrears applies to unpaid amounts on calls already made, not uncalled amounts."
    },
    {
      "option": "C",
      "status": "supported",
      "false_part": "",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "The amount received in advance is a liability of the company and should be credited to ‘Call in Advance Account.”",
      "reason": "Accurately describes accounting treatment and balance sheet nature of calls received in advance."
    },
    {
      "option": "D",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Credit it to Securities Premium Reserve A/c as a capital reserve of the company",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "The amount received in advance is a liability of the company and should be credited to ‘Call in Advance Account.”",
      "reason": "Securities premium is for issue price over face value, not advance call payments."
    }
  ]
}
